1445-4871-8249-8347.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4871-8249-8347.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Sela triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1084-1385-4279.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
An opponent controls a creature.
1084-1385-4279.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
When the sacrificed creature dies, Zulaport Cutthroat triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature an opponent controls, and causing you to draw a card.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
1084-1385-4279.notes: You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control. The lock will end once you've drawn your library.

2921-5034-5660-6769.easyPrerequisites: Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2921-5034-5660-6769.description:
Cast Sol Ring by paying its mana cost.
When Sol Ring enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Sol Ring, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Sol Ring from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

2023-3755-4518-7175.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

728-2178-4147-4215.easyPrerequisites: Thornbite Staff attached to Hua Tuo.
728-2178-4147-4215.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional nontoken green creature.
Hua Tuo does not have summoning sickness.
728-2178-4147-4215.description:
During your precombat main phase, activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the additional nontoken green creature.
When the creature dies, Verdant Succession and Hua Tuo trigger.
Holding priority, activate Hua Tuo by tapping it, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Hua Tuo trigger from step 2, untapping it.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for the sacrificed creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3240-4247-6462-7422.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1170-2099-3446-5131--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-2099-3446-5131--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Herald of Kozilek.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Sarcatog +1/+1 until end of turn
Repeat.

1170-5131-6798-7052--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-5131-6798-7052--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Savvy Trader.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the artifact, causing you to surveil 1
Repeat.

2448-5220-6900-7918.easyPrerequisites: It is your precombat main phase.
2448-5220-6900-7918.description:
Cast Goblin Firestarter by paying its mana cost.
Activate Goblin Firestarter by sacrificing it.
When Goblin Firestarter dies, Mortuary and Sifa Grent trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Goblin Firestarter from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing target opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Cast Goblin Firestarter from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

433-573-7857.description:
Activate Llanowar Scout by tapping it, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Llanowar Scout.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2034-6972-7509.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Gleeful Arsonist
When Gleeful Arsonist dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Gleeful Arsonist
When Gleeful Arsonist dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Repeat.
2034-6972-7509.notes: If Gleeful Arsonist starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

618-7624.description:
Activate the mutated Sea-Dasher Octopus and Kiki-Jiki creature by tapping it, creating a token copy of it with haste.
Repeat.

2060-4222-6842.description:
Activate Iron Spider by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on each artifact creature and Vehicle you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Iron Spider.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness

3259-4460-7208.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4460-7208.description:
Declare Pestered Wellguard and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers. Pestered Wellguard triggers, creating a 1/1 Faerie creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Faerie token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1765-5972-6798.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
1765-5972-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Chishiro triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

560-1563-3899-4885.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

6633-6738-7011-7082.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more Allies.
6633-6738-7011-7082.description:
Cast Razor Boomerang by paying {0} due to Sokka, Swordmaster.
When Razor Boomerang enters, Sokka and Suki's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When the Ally enters, Sokka and Suki's first ability triggers, attaching Razor Boomerang to the Ally token.
Activate the Ally token by tapping it and unattaching Razor Boomerang, dealing 1 damage to any target and returning Razor Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2034-3025-5170-6132.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Bastion of Remembrance triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Bastion of Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

579-1322-2366-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
579-1322-2366-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}{G} due to Mana Reflection.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

1669-3234-3293-5256.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
1669-3234-3293-5256.description:
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat
1669-3234-3293-5256.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

1350-2793-6760.notablePrerequisites: Adagia has twelve or more charge counters on it.
1350-2793-6760.description:
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
Activate Adagia by paying {3}{W} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Ugin's Nexus.
Put the Ugin's Nexus token into exile due to the legend rule and its replacement effect, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Ugin's Nexus from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

2457-4289-6633-6753.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

560-2558-2921-5727.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters the battlefield, The Prydwen triggers.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Prydwen trigger, creating a 2/2 Human Knight and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Soldier.
Repeat from step 2.

2468-3094-3401.notablePrerequisites:
Artifacts you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
Artifacts you control can tap to produce at least {4}.
You are able to cast Blinkmoth Infusion.
2468-3094-3401.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Panoptic Mirror triggers.
Holding priority, activate any number of artifacts you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Panoptic Mirror's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Panoptic Mirror's trigger, casting a copy of Blinkmoth Infusion without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Blinkmoth Infusion, untapping all artifacts.
Repeat from step 2.
Cast Blinkmoth Infusion by paying its mana cost reduced by the number of artifacts you control.
Holding priority, activate all mana-producing artifacts you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}.
Activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a copy of Blinkmoth Infusion.
Resolve the Blinkmoth Infusion copy, untapping all artifacts.
Repeat from step 2.

4970-5671-5751-6289.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one land card in hand.
4970-5671-5751-6289.description:
Cast Chromatic Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0} and discarding a land card from your hand.
Activate Chromatic Sphere by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1} and causing you to mill two cards and return a land card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2498-4417-4691.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 3.
2498-4417-4691.description:
Activate Hex Parasite by paying 2 life.
Vilis triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Sheoldred's first ability triggers twice, causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat as desired.
Resolve all Hex Parasite abilities.

3490-4050-4733-6242.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature, adding {1}.
When the creature dies, Dictate of Erebos triggers, causing each opponent to sacrifice a creature.
Legate Lanius triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat until no opponent controls a creature.
3490-4050-4733-6242.notes: You may repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponents control, using the Servo generated from the last iteration.

1069-1232-3480-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-1232-3480-5499.description:
Activate Nemata's first ability by paying {2}{G}, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Saproling.
Activate the Saproling by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Axonil, Deepest Might // Temple of Power

2868-5256-5551.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to defeat Invasion of Amonkhet.
2868-5256-5551.description:
Defeat Invasion of Amonkhet
Invasion of Amonkhet triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Axonil that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Lazotep Convert.
When Lazotep Convert dies, it triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Axonil that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Lazotep Convert's power.
Repeat from step 4.

2835-4191-5010-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Golgari Thug.
When Golgari Thug dies, it and Fecundity trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Thug trigger, putting it on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Fecundity trigger, causing you to draw Golgari Thug from the top of your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to Golgari Thug's power.
Cast Golgari Thug by paying {0} due to Aluren.
Repeat.

593-4591-5109.description:
Cast Volcano Hellion by paying {2}{R}{R}.
Volcano Hellion enters the battlefield, dealing an arbitrarily large amount of damage to Mogg Maniac and you.
You do not lose the game due to having zero or less life due to Platinum Angel.
Mogg Maniac triggers, dealing an arbitarily large amount of damage to target opponent.

2634-3351-4280-5195.description:
Cast Through the Breach by paying {4}{R}.
Storm-Kiln Artist and Veyran trigger twice.
Resolve the Veyran triggers, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Through the Breach.
Storm-Kiln Artist and Veyran trigger twice.
Resolve the Veyran triggers, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the copy of Through the Breach, putting Rootha from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 5.

2201-3983.description:
Godhead of Awe causes all other creatures to have base power and toughness of 1/1.
Night of Souls' Betrayal gives all other creatures -1/-1.
Any creature that enters the battlefield will do so as a 0/0 creature, and will die as a state-based action due to having zero or less toughness.

1725-4761.description:
Players cannot draw cards due to Omen Machine.
At the beginning of each player's draw step, Omen Machnie triggers, exiling the top card of that player's library and allowing them to cast it, if able.
Teferi only allows opponent to cast spells at sorcery speed, thus forbidding them from casting the cast exiled by Omen Machine, unless it is a land card.

2393-3240-4871-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
When Nether Traitor dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Sifter of Skulls trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Sifter of Skulls trigger, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia trigger, causing target player to mill one card.
Activate the Eldrazi Scion token by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Scion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Nether Traitor trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating another Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Resolve Nether Traitor's trigger, paying {B} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
